does: A dice node of the stats expression evaluator that rolls dice whose size comes from an action resource of the roller (the eoc::ActionResourcesComponent read first), such as Bardic Inspiration's die, through eoc::roll::stream::RollManager::RollDice on the Generic stream; the sibling of unplaced::RollExpressionPlainDice.

evidence.says: takes the ActionResourcesComponent of the context's entity, builds RollDefinitions (0xC bytes each) from the node and calls RollManager::RollDice per definition; pairs with a case of the Toolkit's expression switch at 0.52
the direct caller of RollManager::RollDice for Bardic Inspiration's d6 on a save; the roll log row of that die has no roller and origin unknown

questions.ask: Which expressions reach it besides an action-resource die: a Superiority die (Battle Master maneuvers) or Cutting Words would show; the roll log should list it as an asker.
